world_read.summary: A landscape watercolor-and-ink plate on a flat turquoise ground. On the left, three stacked line-drawn anime face echoes (eyes closed, eye open and crying with an open mouth, eyes closed) dissolve into vertical indigo/cobalt hair drips. On the right, three torn indigo-violet stain islands each hold a creature fragment: a ridged lavender horn at the top, a reptilian eye with an amber-orange slit-pupil iris and red/magenta-flecked scaly skin in the middle, and a pale cream fang comb dripping toward the bottom edge. A thin red horizontal line runs from the girl's cheek into the amber eye. The eye is the only hot accent, so it is the focal point. It is painted to look luminous but casts no actual light on the ground.
